tools.name: search_advertisers
tools.description: Search AdSpendSpy's Meta Ad Library database for an advertiser or brand by name. Returns up to five matching brands with category, logo, number of active ads where known, and the page_id. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: find_similar_advertisers
tools.description: List up to six tracked advertisers similar to a brand (same Facebook page category or niche), each with category, active ads where known, estimated 30-day spend range and one top ad. No sign-in needed. Pass page_id when known, otherwise the exact brand name.

tools.name: compare_advertisers
tools.description: Compare 2 to 6 tracked advertisers side by side: category, active ads where known, estimated 30-day spend range and one top ad each. A name AdSpendSpy does not track is listed as not tracked and never replaced by a similar brand. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_tracked_brands
tools.description: List your actively tracked advertisers and their string page_id values.

tools.name: search_tracked_brands
tools.description: Search your tracked advertisers by name, Meta page ID, or stored Facebook URL. Searches existing local data only; does not resolve vanity URLs through paid providers.

tools.name: check_brands_tracked
tools.description: Check whether each string Meta page ID is actively tracked by your account.

tools.description: Add a known advertiser to your tracked brands before reading its ads. Changes your AdSpendSpy account: the advertiser joins your tracked brands and AdSpendSpy starts importing its ads. tools.description: Read your saved lists, with ad creatives limited to advertisers you actively track. list_id selects one owned list; ad_id reports which of your lists contain that internal ad ID and takes precedence when both are supplied. Saving an ad does not bypass tracking limits.
